summary: Independent review of exact PR head 3e6ebed found fresh-install and recovery risks in database initialization, malformed activation commands, one remaining service-account token mount, incomplete ephemeral-image negatives, and incomplete private-registry linkage coverage.
validation: Four independent read-only lanes reviewed exact commit 3e6ebed709bc0dc1e60fda968b7dbf9ef7526073.
Controller materialization review rendered all eight components and found no ownership or inventory blocker.
Runtime-security review linted/rendered the exact head and found no CEL, security-context, registry, or proxy-token blocker.
Database review traced Job ordering and initializer source behavior through common-backend.
QA/operations review audited executable runbook commands and negative/private-image test coverage.
blockers: Initializer ordering creates ExternalSecret objects but does not wait for their target Secrets before the five-minute Job deadline.
The shipped schema initializer is not transactionally/idempotently recoverable after partial DDL failure.
New lobby pull-secret contracts lack lifecycle, rotation, deletion, and recovery documentation.
Platform exact-SHA/blob verification commands in the activation runbook are malformed and cannot execute as written.
Production worker still automounts a Kubernetes API token despite receiving an explicit kubeconfig.
Admission negatives do not exercise malformed/non-Nexus ephemeralContainer references.
Private-image pull-secret validation omits API, worker, proxy, and PostgreSQL workloads.
next_action: Return to code; fix the lc-config gaps, make the application initializer transactionally retryable with a released immutable API image, update the prod pin, and rerun all local gates.

issues.title: Initializer does not wait for ExternalSecret target Secrets
issues.details: Sync waves order resources, not asynchronous secret reconciliation; a fresh install can exhaust the Job deadline before DB or pull credentials exist.

issues.title: Database initializer cannot safely resume partial schema creation
issues.details: Schema DDL lacks an encompassing transaction/idempotent migration path; retries after a mid-script failure can remain permanently broken.

issues.title: Lobby pull-secret lifecycle is undocumented
issues.details: The new production/offline credential targets need creation, rotation, deletion, retention, and recovery contracts.

issues.title: Platform SHA verification commands are malformed
issues.details: The activation runbook omits required git -C, test comparison, and command substitution syntax for Platform checks.

issues.title: Production worker automounts an unnecessary API token
issues.details: The worker receives an explicit kubeconfig but its service account still automounts the in-cluster token.

issues.title: Admission negatives do not exercise ephemeralContainers
issues.details: A regression in effective ephemeral-container enforcement could pass current string-level checks.

issues.title: Private-image pull-secret validation is incomplete
issues.details: API, worker, proxy, and PostgreSQL rendered workloads are not asserted against their controller-rendered Nexus credential resources.
